svg.title: Black White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. The photograph shows a square split diagonally into black upper-left and white lower-right triangles. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.glenstone.org/artworks/black-white; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
